text: 2026年11月8日至9日，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能出席国际清算银行（BIS）在瑞士巴塞尔举行的行长例会。与会央行行长就全球经济金融形势、外汇市场运行、央行资产负债表、人工智能等议题开展了深入交流。会议期间，宣昌能副行长还会见了部分与会央行代表，就共同关心的问题和双边金融合作交换了意见。
text_en: From November 8 to 9, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng attended the regular meeting of central bank governors held by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) in Basel, Switzerland. The attending central bank governors held in-depth exchanges on topics including the global economic and financial situation, foreign exchange market operations, central bank balance sheets and artificial intelligence. During the meeting, Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng also met with some attending central bank representatives to exchange views on issues of common concern and bilateral financial cooperation.
